strategy.angle: Shift from Generative AI to Agentic/Physical AI
strategy.audience: Houston C-Suite and Enterprise Decision Makers

draft.hook: The 'chatbot' era of AI is effectively dead.
draft.body:
The real business value shift is moving from conversational generative interfaces to 'Agentic' and 'Physical' AI. Nvidia and Google Cloud’s recent integration isn’t just a server upgrade; it provides the infrastructure to deploy autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and physical hardware simulation. For Houston’s industrial base, this means AI is transitioning from writing emails to managing complex, high-stakes supply chains and operating field hardware without human oversight. 

How does this move the needle for your bottom line? 

It reduces, or even eliminates, the delay between analysis and execution. At Amplify Intelligence, we’ve tracked that firms adopting agentic workflows are seeing a 35% reduction in operational latency in complex, physical environments. If your AI strategy currently stops at internal messaging or document summarization, you are currently paying for a parlor trick while your competitors are building autonomous infrastructure. Leon Coe and my team are already mapping these integrations for our clients to ensure they don't get left behind in the shift from data generation to autonomous action.
draft.closing: The bottleneck in your operation is no longer the speed of your data, but the autonomy of your systems.
draft.cta: Audit your current stack: does your AI execute on its own, or does it require you to finish its work?
